issues.detail: Hebrew 'בִגְדֵי חֹפֶשׁ' means 'garments of freedom/free garments' (i.e., loose or festive clothing), but Vietnamese renders it as 'những tấm vải giao ước' ('covenant cloths'), which is an unsupported addition and changes the meaning. The word 'giao ước' (covenant) has no basis in the Hebrew text.
